info.name: E-commerce Platform
info.description:
Manual test suite for the whole platform, through Nginx (http://localhost:8080). Run the folders top to bottom, or the whole collection with the Runner.

Before you start: run `./scripts/setup.sh` from the repository root once. It starts everything and loads the demo data; the admin used here is the seeded admin@example.com / password123, and the search examples use the seeded products.

Useful pages: the admin panel http://localhost:8080, Swagger http://localhost:8080/api/docs, emails in Mailpit http://localhost:8025.

Rate limits: register 3/min and login 5/min per IP. Running "1. Auth" twice within a minute hits 429, so wait a minute.

request.description: 201 the first time, 409 "Email is already registered" afterwards (both fine). DB: users table, password is a bcrypt $2b$12$ hash.
Paste the accessToken into https://jwt.io to see the claims: sub, email, role, jti (unique per login), iat, exp.

exec: pm.test('role is admin (run ./scripts/setup.sh to load the demo admin)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().user.role).to.eql('admin'));

pm.test('sku upper-cased, slug generated, price as money string', () => { pm.expect(p.sku).to.match(/^KB-/); pm.expect(p.slug).to.match(/^keyboard-/); pm.expect(p.price).to.eql('12.50'); pm.expect(p.stock).to.eql(5); });

request.description: DB: products, inventories (quantity 5) and inventory_movements (+5 "initial"). Redis: products:cache-version was incremented.
Send twice. Medis/redis-cli: a key products:v<N>:list:<hash> appears with a TTL of 60 s; the second call is served from it.

exec: pm.test('paid, total 25.00, price snapshot', () => { pm.expect(o.status).to.eql('paid'); pm.expect(o.total).to.eql('25.00'); pm.expect(o.items[0].unitPrice).to.eql('12.50'); pm.expect(o.paymentReference).to.match(/^mock_/); });

request.description:
Check afterwards:
- Mailpit (http://localhost:8025): "Your order ORD-... is confirmed" sent to customer@example.test
- DB: orders (paid), order_items, inventory_movements (-2 "sale"), inventories quantity 3
- Redis: idempotency:OrdersController.create:<userId>:<key> stored for 24h; bull:order-emails:completed

request.description: DB: a payment_failed order with movements -1 "sale" and +1 "cancellation". No email. Stock stays 3.
